macros.name: arrayrowsepdim
macros.doc: There is a new dimension register \arrayrowsepdim to hold the minimal interline space.

macros.name: delimgrowth
macros.doc: In display mode this is controlled by a count \delimgrowth. Setting the \delimgrowth to n makes (approx.) every nth delimiter bigger.

macros.name: double
macros.doc: The newly introduced modifiers \double and \triple create double and triple delimiters.

macros.name: eqno
macros.doc: \eqno{A} makes A the equation number.

macros.name: inline
macros.doc: Commands \inline and \displayed force either mode on a subexpression.

macros.name: lAngle
macros.doc: mathematical left double angle bracket

macros.name: lBrack
macros.doc: mathematical left white square bracket

macros.name: lt
macros.doc: As symbols of ordering, < and > can be always accessed through ‘\lt’ and ‘\gt’.

macros.name: mathindent
macros.doc: Displayed formulas are indented by \mathindent of default value of 4 pc.

macros.name: Mid
macros.doc: The middle delimiters, such as \mid and \middle| for |, \Mid and \double| for ||, and \triple| for |||, have the size of the nearest outer pair of delimiters.

macros.name: natherrormark
macros.doc: Nath errors are visualized by (or whatever is \natherrormark) placed where the error manifests itself (which may look misplaced).

macros.name: nathstyle
macros.doc: The command \nathstyle accepts a list of arguments of the form ‘name=value’ or ‘name’; the latter having the same meaning as ‘name=on’.

macros.name: old
macros.doc: A number of math commands have been redefined; \old{command } often provides access to what \command was before Nath redefined it (see the source code of this guide for examples).

macros.name: ot
macros.doc: Arrows \to, \ot, \otto, and \mapsto are expandable and descriptable via sub- and superscripts.

macros.name: otto
macros.doc: Arrows \to, \ot, \otto, and \mapsto are expandable and descriptable via sub- and superscripts.

macros.name: paritem
macros.doc: Nath’s command \paritem{item label } starts a numbered paragraph and may occur even within a displayed formula.

macros.name: rAngle
macros.doc: mathematical right double angle bracket

macros.name: rBrack
macros.doc: mathematical right white square bracket

macros.name: triple
macros.doc: The newly introduced modifiers \double and \triple create double and triple delimiters.

macros.name: wall
macros.doc: The \wall makes every next line to start at the “wall” until removed by \return.

envs.name: tight
envs.doc: Within the tight environment, displayed formulas occupy slightly less horizontal space.
